tasks.subject: Task 1: EM IR + completion serializer + em-builder
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Lower a hierarchy EM (EquipmentModuleV2) + its state-machine contract (EquipmentModuleContract) into an EmSequence IR, with a new serialize-completion.ts for CompletionCriterion[] -> SCL.

**Files:** Create serialize-completion.ts, em-builder.ts + tests; Modify types.ts (EmSeqStep/EmSeqState/EmSequence), sa-builder.ts (export staticEntries), index.ts (export buildEmSequence).

**Verify:** npx vitest run src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/__tests__/em-builder.test.ts src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/__tests__/serialize-completion.test.ts

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/serialize-completion.ts", "src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/em-builder.ts", "src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/types.ts", "src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/sa-builder.ts", "src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/index.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/__tests__/em-builder.test.ts src/lib/spec-builder/codegen/__tests__/serialize-completion.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["buildEmSequence produces ordered states, role-tagged pins, static commands, linear steps with fillId+advance, exits", "serialize-completion lowers CompletionCriterion[] to SCL boolean"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Hybrid AI-fill (em-fill-prompt + use-em-generate)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Generic, contract-driven AI prompt + orchestrator that replaces ONLY the marked SFC step-body regions, always falling back to deterministic stubs.

**Files:** Create src/lib/spec-builder/em-fill-prompt.ts, src/hooks/use-em-generate.ts + tests.

**MANUAL self-check:** em-fill-prompt.ts matches CLAUDE.md *-prompt*.ts glob -> confirm generic across machine types.

**Verify:** npx vitest run src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/em-fill-prompt.test.ts src/hooks/__tests__/use-em-generate.test.ts

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/spec-builder/em-fill-prompt.ts", "src/hooks/use-em-generate.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/lib/spec-builder/__tests__/em-fill-prompt.test.ts src/hooks/__tests__/use-em-generate.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["emFillBriefs one brief per sequential step, bare sclName region ids", "system prompt generic (no machine names), forbids skeleton edits", "fillEmFb replaces only valid non-empty regions; AI failure keeps stubs + warning", "useEmGenerate thin pending+run hook"]}
```
